$comment: Delivery milestones for the AMF-PSM robustness programme, as code. tools/sync_milestones.py reconciles this manifest with the repository's Milestones section; it creates and updates, and never deletes. Edit here, never in the GitHub UI, or the next sync will overwrite the drift.

milestones.title: D01 - Numerical determinism core
milestones.description:
**Phase A - Numerical determinism & invariants** | Day 1 of 20 | due Thu 20 Aug 2026

> **Status:** Delivered - see CHANGELOG [Unreleased].

**Tasks**

- [ ] Add `amf.numeric` with `stable_sum` (exactly rounded), `square` (correctly rounded), `clip_unit`.
- [ ] Replace `(w / total) ** 2` in `diagnostics.concentration` - `**` routes to libm `pow`, which is not required to be correctly rounded.
- [ ] Route pair-weight aggregation, the diagnostic roll-up, and the simulation reductions through `stable_sum`.
- [ ] Test the primitives against exact rational arithmetic, not against a second float expression.

**Acceptance criteria**

- `ruff`, `ruff format --check`, and `mypy --strict` all silent; coverage still 100%.
- Every per-system concentration score on `examples/sample_market.json` is unchanged.
- Any last-place movement in a published score is recorded in CHANGELOG with before/after values.

milestones.title: D02 - Invariant guard at the engine boundary
milestones.description:
**Phase A - Numerical determinism & invariants** | Day 2 of 20 | due Fri 21 Aug 2026

> **Status:** Delivered - see CHANGELOG [Unreleased].

**Tasks**

- [ ] Add `InvariantError` to the `AMFError` hierarchy in `errors.py`.
- [ ] Add `amf.invariants`: `require_unit` / `require_non_negative` / `require_finite` plus `check_*` for each result type.
- [ ] Wire the guards into `DiagnosticEngine.diagnose`, `ShockSimulator.propagate`, `SensitivityAnalyzer.analyse`, `DependencyGraph.centrality`.
- [ ] Use raised exceptions, never `assert` - assertions are stripped under `python -O`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- Each guard has both a rejecting and an accepting test, built from deliberately broken result objects.
- The guards are always on: no `strict` flag anyone can forget to set.
- Coverage remains 100% including every raise branch.

milestones.title: D03 - Fix the two live determinism defects
milestones.description:
**Phase A - Numerical determinism & invariants** | Day 3 of 20 | due Mon 24 Aug 2026

> **Status:** Delivered - see CHANGELOG [Unreleased].

**Tasks**

- [ ] `DependencyGraph.centrality` - iterate incoming influence in system declaration order instead of dict insertion order.
- [ ] `ShockSimulator._score` - measure the settling penalty against the horizon actually run, not against `max_steps`.
- [ ] Add an exhaustive 720-permutation regression in `test_graph.py` and a hypothesis permutation property in `test_properties.py`.
- [ ] Add a multi-wave regression pinning the corrected settling term.

**Acceptance criteria**

- 0 of 1,000 dependency permutations change the centrality vector (was 265 of 400).
- The settling penalty stays inside [0, 1] for a shock scheduled past `max_steps`.
- Single-shock resilience scores are provably unchanged, since their horizon equals `max_steps`.
